232347: Fena, the protagonist, is a princess who has escaped from Shangri-La and the British Empire. She recruits a group of samurai and ninjas known as the Seven Samurai to help her on her journey and becomes their captain.
232348: Shitan is one of the seven samurai who help and join Fena in his quest. He is portrayed as aloof, but easygoing, with a strong feeling for his friends. Shitan also shows loyalty and devotion to his companions when he joins Fena's crew with his comrades.
232351: Kaede's elder twin. They both use a spear and wakizashi in battle, they're both friendly and mischievous, but Enju feels he's more dependable than his younger brother.
232353: This mountain of a boy prefers fighting in close quarters with brass knuckles. When he's not fighting, he's kind-hearted and mild-mannered.
232354: An older knight who was once called "Salman the Onslaught" for being so deadly with a spear. He's known Fena since she was a girl as he served the Houtman family for some time.
232355: Yukimaru is the leader of the Seven Samurai who helps and joins Fena in his quest. Yukimaru is an introverted and stoic individual. He is extremely protective of Fena Houtman, whom he has known since childhood.
232356: Raised by a family of blacksmiths, Karin geeks out over technology like her rifle, which she uses to great effect in battle.
232357: Enju's younger twin. They both use a spear and wakizashi in battle, they're both friendly and mischievous, but Kaede feels he's more manly than his elder brother.
232360: An older knight who served the Houtman family and possessed an intimidating nickname in his younger days—"Otto the Blitz" for his quick swordplay.
232361: The oldest and most mature member of the group, he manages everyone's wild energy. He's also the cook, but when he fights, he uses a short ninja sword.
244369: A mysterious lord who is after Fena for his own reasons and searches for her on his ship called the Blue Giant. One of them is that he fell in love with Fena's late mother Helena and knows what her family can do.
248021: A boy who works as Abel's aide. He handles everything from daily life to dealing with guests with ease. He has a well-rounded face like a Western doll.
248024: A female captain who leads the pirate group "Rumble Rose". A beautiful woman with good looks, she is strong-willed, competitive, and proud. At the request of a certain person, she is targets Fena.
248919: A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She uses a rapier and a crescent moon sword, and despite her cute appearance, she has a black heart. She adores O'Malley more than any other member of the crew.
248920: A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. Although she is quite small, she is a highly skilled sniper. She wears an eye patch because she admires O'Malley.
248921: A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She has a handsome face, but her pride is high and she is determined to win. She uses a dagger knife and fights with all her might. (Official site, translated)
248922: A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She is the mood maker and trouble maker of the crew. She is good at physical training and has a cheerful and optimistic personality, but her temper becomes fierce during battle. (Official site, translated)
248923: A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She has a muscular build and is very strong. Her fighting style is belligerent, but she is a dependable and caring member of the crew.
248924: A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She is very slender and has a mysterious atmosphere. She is good at sneaky tricks and outwitting her opponents.
248925: A female pirate belonging to the Rumble Rose. She is always calm and is considered to be O'Malley's right-hand woman as well as her chief strategist. She is good at physical attacks and has a large sword wound in her left eye.
250557: A Nobel Frenchwoman who is the former maiden and the descendant of Joan of arc and the mother of Fena Houtman. She is the old childhood friend and lover of Abel Bluefield.
251220: Brule is a dog who followed Fena in her flight.
